comments.author: mcclainhalestone
comments.body_html: I was wondering how to fit a 3x1-sized magazine into the rig, so thank you.

comments.author: McDewgle
comments.body_html: Not to be a party pooper but there’s a mod that already does this Slimmer Magazines

comments.author: desze
comments.body_html: Yes, but mine only changes mags that are 3x1, which are usually the 40, 45 and 50 rounds capacity ones.

comments.author: neverwinternightshift
comments.body_html: Under normal circumstances, there are rigs in the game that allow you to hold 3x1 mags, but they’re not overly common. And they usually come at a storage cost, as they have less overall slots than some of the best rigs. I vastly prefer mods like these to have a less realistic, but more consistent storage layout.

comments.author: _HAVOC_
comments.body_html:
It’s a good mod because it gives the player more options, so they aren’t stuck with just the same 1–3 vests. Plus, with most vests, you can usually only carry 3 or 4 40-round mags.

However, I don’t like the fact that only the size of the slots was changed. The magazine icons are still the same, and they’re larger than the slots themselves. It looks bad.

Is there any way you could adjust the icons using an image editing program?

Do you need any help with that?

comments.author: desze
comments.body_html: Try doing what it says in the description under “IMPORTANT,” if you don’t clean the temporary files after installing the mod the icons will be bugged.

comments.author: IZZY_1979
comments.body_html: Am I the only one who reads the horizontal first and the vertical second? I see these as 1x3 not 3x1. Surely I’m not the only one.
